meta.method: GitHub metadata, explicit relationships, cross-references, and documented keyword rules. No AI enrichment.
meta.planning_note: Dates use two parallel tracks per workstream and default effort: verify 2, showstopper 3, critical 4, bug 5, task 4, feature 8 working days.

workstreams.name: Accuracy
workstreams.description: False positives, false negatives, and correctness of clone claims.

workstreams.name: Detection engine
workstreams.description: Parsing, matching, scoring, embeddings, and cluster formation.

workstreams.name: Performance & live
workstreams.description: Incremental analysis, caches, memory, scheduling, and throughput.

workstreams.name: Editor experience
workstreams.description: VS Code, JetBrains, diagnostics, panels, hovers, and webviews.

workstreams.name: CLI, MCP & automation
workstreams.description: Command-line, MCP, actions, and agent-facing workflows.

workstreams.name: Release & delivery
workstreams.description: Packaging, signing, releases, deployment, and platform contracts.

workstreams.name: Reporting & metrics
workstreams.description: Human-readable reports, metrics, summaries, and documentation.

workstreams.name: Quality system
workstreams.description: Tests, specifications, CI, fixtures, and repository health.

priorities.name: Verify next release

priorities.name: Protect accuracy

priorities.name: Critical path

priorities.name: Fix defects

priorities.name: Planned product work

priorities.name: Maintenance & tasks
